data.one_liner: Capture full‑page Flutter screenshots, including off‑screen content, via a simple API.
data.what_it_does: The package renders a widget tree to an image, scrolling internally to capture content that is not visible on screen. It returns the screenshot as a Base64 string and can also save it automatically.
use_when: You need to export a complete view of a scrollable widget as an image
You want a quick way to share or archive long lists or pages
Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux) is required
avoid_when: Real‑time video or animation capture is needed
You require fine‑grained control over image format or compression beyond Base64
strengths: Very simple API – just call captureAndSaveScreenshot with a GlobalKey
Works on all major Flutter platforms
No additional native setup or permissions required
weaknesses: May be memory‑intensive for very large scrollable content
Limited to static screenshots – no video or animated capture
